question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Click "Forgot password" on the login page and enter the email address of your account. We send a reset link that is valid for 1 hour. If the email does not arrive within a few minutes, check your spam folder.

question: How do I change the email address on my account?
answer: Go to Settings > Account > Email, enter the new address and confirm it with your current password. We send a verification link to the new address; the change takes effect once you click it.

question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
answer: Go to Settings > Security > Two-factor authentication and scan the QR code with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or 1Password. Save the backup codes we show you in a safe place; they are the only way back into your account if you lose your phone.

question: I lost my phone and can't log in with two-factor authentication. What can I do?
answer: Use one of the backup codes you saved when you enabled two-factor authentication. If you don't have them, contact support from the email address on your account; we verify your identity before disabling two-factor authentication, which can take up to 3 business days.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Go to Settings > Account > Delete account. Your files are kept for 30 days in case you change your mind, then permanently deleted. An active paid subscription is cancelled automatically, without a refund for the remaining period.

question: What plans do you offer?
answer: Free (5 GB storage), Personal (200 GB, $4.99/month), Pro (2 TB, $11.99/month) and Team ($9.99 per user per month, 5 TB shared). Yearly billing gives two months free on all paid plans.

question: How do I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Change plan. Upgrades take effect immediately and you pay the prorated difference. Downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing period; if you use more storage than the new plan allows, uploads are paused until you free up space.

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and Apple Pay. Team plans billed yearly can also pay by bank transfer against an invoice.

question: Can I get a refund?
answer: Monthly plans are not refundable. Yearly plans can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase or renewal. To request a refund, contact support with your invoice number.

question: Where can I download my invoices?
answer: All invoices are available under Settings > Billing > Invoices as PDF. You can add your company name and VAT number there; they appear on all future invoices.

question: What happens if my payment fails?
answer: We retry the charge 3 times over 7 days and email you each time. If all attempts fail, your account is moved to the Free plan. Your files stay safe, but uploads are paused while you are over the Free plan limit.

question: What is the maximum file size I can upload?
answer: Up to 2 GB per file on the Free plan and up to 50 GB per file on paid plans. Large files are uploaded in chunks, so an interrupted upload resumes where it stopped.

question: Which file types can I store?
answer: Any file type. Previews in the browser are available for images, PDFs, Office documents, text files, audio and video.

question: How do I share a file or folder?
answer: Right-click the file or folder and choose Share. You can invite people by email (they need an account) or create a link that anyone can open. Paid plans can protect links with a password and set an expiry date.

question: How do I stop sharing a link?
answer: Open the file's Share dialog and click "Disable link". Anyone with the old link immediately loses access. You can see all your active links under Settings > Sharing.

question: Can I restore a deleted file?
answer: Yes. Deleted files go to Trash and can be restored for 30 days on the Free plan and 180 days on paid plans. After that they are permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.

question: Can I restore an older version of a file?
answer: Yes, on paid plans. Right-click the file and choose Version history to see and restore previous versions from the last 180 days. The Free plan keeps versions for 7 days.

question: Is my data encrypted?
answer: Yes. Files are encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256. Pro and Team plans can additionally enable end-to-end encrypted folders, which we cannot read; if you forget the folder password, its contents cannot be recovered.

question: Where are my files stored?
answer: Files are stored in data centers in the EU (Frankfurt and Amsterdam). Team plans can choose US storage (Virginia) when the workspace is created; the region cannot be changed later.

question: Do you have desktop and mobile apps?
answer: Yes. Desktop apps are available for Windows, macOS and Linux and keep a folder on your computer in sync. Mobile apps for iOS and Android can upload photos automatically.

question: Why are my files not syncing?
answer: First check that the desktop app shows "Up to date" or "Syncing" and that you are not over your storage limit. Pausing and resuming sync from the app menu fixes most issues. Files with names longer than 255 characters or containing characters like : or * on Windows are skipped and listed under Sync issues.

question: How do I add members to my team?
answer: Team admins can invite members under Admin console > Members > Invite. Each new member is added to the next invoice, prorated for the rest of the billing period.

question: What happens to a team member's files when they leave?
answer: When an admin removes a member, their files are transferred to an admin of the admin's choice. Files in shared team folders stay where they are.

question: Do you have an API?
answer: Yes, a REST API is available on Pro and Team plans. Create an API token under Settings > Developer. The rate limit is 1000 requests per hour per token.

question: How do I contact support?
answer: Email support@example.com or use the chat in the app. Free plan requests are answered within 3 business days, paid plans within 24 hours, and Team plans have priority support with a 4-hour response time on business days.
